notes.title: Acme launch review

frontmatter.summary: Launch fixed for 15 Feb 2027, Contentful chosen as blog CMS, budget raised to 95000 EUR.

notes.body:
## Summary
Launch review for the [Acme website](../../projects/acme-website/project.md) with [Maria López](../people/maria-lopez.md), [Carlos Ruiz](../people/carlos-ruiz.md) and [Lucía Fernández](../people/lucia-fernandez.md). The team fixed the launch for 15 February 2027 and chose Contentful as the blog CMS. The budget rises to 95000 EUR.

## Decisions
- [Launch the Acme website on 15 February 2027](../decisions/2026-12-10-launch-the-acme-website-on-15-february-2027.md)
- [Use Contentful as the blog CMS](../decisions/2026-12-10-use-contentful-as-the-blog-cms.md)
- Send the launch announcement draft on Fridays for review (tentative).

## Facts
- Budget raised to 95000 EUR to cover the CMS licence.
- Carlos is now tech lead for the website.

## Action items
- Set up the Contentful space — Carlos Ruiz — 2026-12-17
- Write the blog launch post — Lucía Fernández — no date

## Open questions
- [Who writes the Acme blog copy after launch?](../questions/who-writes-the-acme-blog-copy-after-launch.md)

## Risks
- [Migrating old blog posts to Contentful could delay the launch](../questions/migrating-old-blog-posts-to-contentful-could-delay-the.md)

notes.title: Launch the Acme website on 15 February 2027

frontmatter.summary: Acme website launches on 15 Feb 2027, after the CMS migration.

notes.body:
## Decision
Launch the website on 15 February 2027, after the CMS migration.

## Context
The launch had been planned for February 2027 without a fixed day.

## Consequences
The CMS migration must finish before the launch. ^[inferred]

## Sources
- [Acme launch review, 10 Dec](../meetings/2026-12-10-acme-launch-review.md)

notes.title: Use Contentful as the blog CMS

frontmatter.summary: Acme's blog runs on Contentful rather than a custom CMS; chosen over Strapi for its editor.

notes.body:
## Decision
Use Contentful as the CMS for the blog, instead of building one.

## Context
Carlos compared it with Strapi; the team chose Contentful for its editor.

## Consequences
The budget rises to cover the CMS licence.

## Sources
- [Acme launch review, 10 Dec](../meetings/2026-12-10-acme-launch-review.md)
